$comment: Two kinds of entry live here, and they are NOT the same thing:
- an assessed waiver: we read the finding, it cannot reach anything we
ship, and the reason states the evidence (see alert:dependabot:230).
- a time-boxed deferral: the finding is real and UNREAD, parked briefly so
a gate can land, with a short expiry forcing the triage.
The reason field says which one it is. Neither is a way to quiet a noisy
gate. Every entry needs a reason, an owner, and an expiry - an expired
waiver stops applying and the finding blocks again, so nothing rots here.
This file lives in git precisely so a waiver is reviewable in a PR and
attributable in `git log`, rather than evaporating with a shell argument.
`verify:*` keys can never be waived: a check that could not RUN must be

alert:dependabot:230.reason: glib 0.18.5 arrives only via Tauri 2.x's GTK backend, which is cfg(target_os = "linux")-gated: it is compiled into the Linux desktop app and the Linux swoop viewer alone, which the .deb ships; the Windows exe and the macOS app never link it (`cargo tree --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc -i glib` prints 'nothing to print'). The finding, GHSA-wrw7-89jp-8q8g, is an unsound Iterator impl on glib::VariantStrIter, an API owlette's own code never calls. No fix exists upstream: Tauri 2.x pins the whole gtk-rs 0.18 stack. Reason reworded 2026-10-02 at the owner's instruction, after the Linux package shipped the app; the acceptance below stands.
alert:dependabot:230.revisit: When Tauri moves the gtk-rs stack to glib 0.20, drop this entry and let the bump land normally.

Mermaid renders only the ```mermaid fences in owlette's own committed docs (web/components/mdx/mermaid.tsx via remarkMdxMermaid in source.config.ts); hoot replies go through react-markdown, not mermaid, so no user or model text reaches katex.
alert:dependabot:376.revisit: When mermaid moves to 12.2.0 or later (katex ^0.18), drop this entry and let the bump land.

alert:dependabot:422.reason: TIME-BOXED DEFERRAL, reachability not settled. glob in the web lockfile arrives through @sentry/nextjs and @sentry/bundler-plugins at build time (glob 13.0.6; the plugin still asks for glob ^13.0.6 in its latest release) and through firebase-admin, @google-cloud/firestore-api, google-gax 5.0.8 and rimraf 5 (glob 10.5.0); the glob 7.2.3 jest brings is below the advisory range. It gets no untrusted input from anything found in that tooling, though whether google-gax ever runs its rimraf path in production is unverified. An override to the fixed majors was tried on 2026-11-01 and broke `npm run test:coverage`: test-exclude 6 promisifies require('glob'), and glob 14 exports an object. The minimatch those globs load moved to 11 on 2026-11-12 through a range-keyed override (alert 428), which leaves jest's and eslint's minimatch 3.x alone. functions and root carry the glob override, so this entry covers web only.
alert:dependabot:422.revisit: Retry the top-level overrides after jest 30 lands on web, and check the eslint plugins that call minimatch as a function. Drop this entry when they hold.
